description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Cost 2 charges of Ghost-Static

Duration 1 minute

Deploy a small secondary drone for a limited time.

You unfold a second, smaller chassis from your kit. The drone is a Tiny construct minion with your Rig's AC, saves, and Perception, and Hit Points equal to your level; it acts when you spend an action to command it. It cannot Redline, cannot carry mods, and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points. When the duration ends it folds itself away.

cinderfall.incomplete: [RIG-NO-ACTOR]/[NO-SPECIALRESOURCE] -- this creates a second, independent minion actor on top of an already-unmodeled Rig; no generic pf2e rule element spawns a full combat-capable minion actor (unlike the familiar case, there is no "summon a battle minion" equivalent generic key -- animal companions/eidolons/summoned minions are each their own deep, class-specific Foundry subsystem, not something a homebrew class can hook via system.rules).
